discovery.input: managed parent short name only (e.g. Schalke 04); parent clubId ~920 is context, not required for the catalog read
steps: Build II catalog name: f'{parentShort} II'
Find early (<~30MB) catalog row: u32le length prefix + exact UTF-8 name bytes
If bytes immediately after the name are another lp32 string ending in ' II', skip that nested name (long/short pair residue)
Require after-name marker: byte0=status (often 01/02), bytes1..10 = 00 00 ff ff ff ff 00 00 01 00
Read affiliate clubId = u32le at after_name + 23

rel.11-22: padding / optional small fields (may be non-zero)

falsePositives.alignPlus24: WRONG — old spike assumed 01 00 00 00 (4-byte status); real layout is 3-byte lead-in so clubId is at +23, not +24
falsePositives.nestedNamePlus23: Reading +23 before skipping nested lp32 can yield garbage (e.g. Borussia Dortmund II → 329 from 'II'+status bytes; VfB Stuttgart II → 65536). Always require marker / skip nested II names.

Schalke 04.note: expected verification output only — do not hardcode as discovery input

crossClubProbe.note: Prior BVB=329 was nested-name false positive; marker+skip yields 31640. VfB requires nested skip ('Stuttgart II' residue) → 7026.
